title: Data Steward
summary: Operational role caring for data on behalf of the owner: definitions, metadata, quality rules and issue resolution.
body_markdown:
# Data Steward

## Purpose

Turn owner decisions into maintained definitions, metadata and quality rules ([[Data Stewardship]]).

## Responsibilities

- Draft and maintain definitions and synonyms.
- Define and monitor quality rules; triage issues.
- Maintain business metadata and reference data.
- Coordinate with custodians on fixes.

## Decision Rights

Proposes at the semantic level; decides on routine metadata maintenance within approved definitions.

## Inputs

Owner decisions; quality measurements; user questions.

## Outputs

Definitions (proposed); rules; issue resolutions; metadata.

## Required Competencies

Domain knowledge; data quality methods; facilitation.

## Escalation Paths

Unresolved issues → [[Data Owner]].
